firstContext: 🤝 Florence is 👁️ Scout now. Sees trouble first. Warns the party on the road.
Travel 3 tiles to trail edge.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Florence freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Rerun is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Wanda opens the pantry wide: 8× Foraged food. Ivy, Sofia, Marcus eat until the fire burns low. The laughter stays low — somebody's seat is empty, and everybody sees it. 🍖 FEASTED ×2.53 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Arc IV burns hotter. Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. Déjà vu with teeth. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: "Stonebridge is eating bark and calling it dinner," Grace says. "We left before we started looking at each other like food."
They're named, every one: Grace Larsen, Felix Fischer, Ruth Weber. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1000 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/9/6), with 4 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 8 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 17 · Craft 6 · Talk 16 · Explore 35 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ivan Villa ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Ivan Villa and Marcus Webb ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.
